title: Ummangaliso Wobungqina Obuthuleyo
intro: Udibana nebali eligutyungelwe ngumntu lokungenelela kukaThixo. Ibali lelungiselelo elimangalisayo kunye nokuzikhusela okungenamazwi okuphindaphindwa ngokuhamba kwexesha. Ungafumanisa ukuba ngubani ojongene nolu vavanyo lungaqhelekanga?
clues: Ndifumene umyalezo ovela kuThixo owandishiya ndimangalisiwe
Abantu bam babuza ubunyulu bam xa ndibuya nomntwana
Ndayalelwa ukuba ndizile ukutya ngenxa yokuthetha okwethutyana
Umthombo wamanzi kunye needati wandixhasa ngexesha lovavanyo lwam
INkosi yam yenze umthi omangalisayo washukunyiswa ukuze undincede
Ingelosi yabonakala kum ikwimo yomntu ogqibeleleyo

outcome.label: Isiphumo
options: Ubumsulwa bam bubonakaliswe xa unyana wam oselusana ethetha
outcome.answer: Ubumsulwa bam bubonakaliswe xa unyana wam oselusana ethetha

verse: Then he called her from below her, 'Do not grieve; your Lord has provided beneath you a stream. And shake toward you the trunk of the palm tree; it will drop upon you ripe, fresh dates.' (Maryam 19:24-25)
arabic: فَنَادَىٰهَا مِن تَحْتِهَا أَلَّا تَحْزَنِي قَدْ جَعَلَ رَبُّكِ تَحْتَكِ سَرِيًّا ﴿٢٤﴾ وَهُزِّي إِلَيْكِ بِجِذْعِ النَّخْلَةِ تُسَاقِطْ عَلَيْكِ رُطَبًا جَنِيًّا ﴿٢٥﴾
